top.para: The workflow that built a talk in a day can present each build-day project: story, infographics, the app and sourced numbers; it shows the power of agentic workflows and is a finite service.

in-short.para: The ask; the pieces exist; the workflow; one prompt; the demonstration; the service; how we recommend build days.

suggestion.para: A participant asked for a quick presentation of each project; the editor replied with the talk's presentation as the model.

pieces.para: The ultimate insider was built in a day by nine agents and one editor, with a site and moving infographics; the book we are writing explains the workflow.

prompt.para: ChatGPT made two infographics of today's six articles: imperfect, and a good picture of what good material allows.

workflow.para: The project, a repository, an agent team that checks, draws and writes, a presentation site, and sharing: by the show and tell or overnight.

power.line: It shows the power of agentic workflows
power.para: Participants see their own work explained back, and see how the workflow did it.

service.para: Presentations of founders' projects, priced per project and handed over, as villager services.

recommend.line: How we recommend running build days
recommend.para: Everyone ships something someone else can use, and a presentation is how they show it.

limits.para: A proposal; ChatGPT's infographics are illustrations with small errors; the talk's timing from its records; the participant unnamed; my interest.

sources.para: My voice memo and group-chat reply of 31 October, and the two infographics.
